hypothesis: Observed instruction means closely follow separate affine functions of area for initial and cached chunks. Removing perimeter and attention terms should give a better-conditioned fit with three predictors.

pcvs.expression: x.shape[0] * x.shape[3] * x.shape[4] if feat_cache is None or feat_cache[feat_idx[0]] is None else 0
pcvs.name: initial_area
pcvs.rationale: Models spatially proportional computation for initial chunks.

pcvs.expression: x.shape[0] * x.shape[3] * x.shape[4] if feat_cache is not None and feat_cache[feat_idx[0]] is not None else 0
pcvs.name: cached_area
pcvs.rationale: Models the larger spatially proportional computation for cached chunks.

pcvs.expression: int(feat_cache is not None and feat_cache[feat_idx[0]] is not None)
pcvs.name: warm_cache
pcvs.rationale: Allows an independent fixed cost for cached execution.
